## Done means
- [ ] a test covers it (new or extended), and it failed before the change
- [ ] `python tests/run_all.py` is green on my machine
- [ ] no client name, real customer data, keys or prices added
- [ ] the co-pilot still never touches OTP, CAPTCHA, passwords, declarations or Submit
- [ ] a database change is a new line at the end of `db.MIGRATIONS`, never an edit
- [ ] HANDOVER.md updated if setup, rules or tasks changed
